name: Chicken Kofta over Turmeric Rice with Cucumber, Tomato & Mint Raita
ingredients: 16 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth
instructions: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a medium saucepan. Add broth and turmeric, then bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.

Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
While the rice is cooking, peel, halve, and mince onion. Divide between two medium bowls (set one bowl aside for the raita).
Peel and mince ginger and garlic; add both to the remaining bowl along with the chicken, bread crumbs, and spices. Using your hands, mix until well combined.
Using a ¼-cup measure, form the chicken mixture into 12 short, sausage-like shapes, approximately 4-inches long; place kofta on a plate.
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add kofta and pan-fry, rotating every 2-3 minutes, until browned and cooked through, 10-12 minutes. Transfer to a clean plate.
Meanwhile, juice lemon into the bowl that was set aside for the raita.
Pick mint leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl.
Trim and small dice cucumber; add to the bowl.
Small dice tomatoes; add to the bowl.
Add yogurt, salt, and pepper to the bowl; stir to combine the raita.
To serve, divide rice, kofta, and raita between plates. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
